title: HPSM-POC: approve the new executive summary words (HPSMPOC-187)?
bluf: Approve these words for the summary's opening: 'The assessment of the organisation produced an overall current score of 62.5 against a target of 100.0, which places it in Red.' becomes 'The organisation scored 62.5 against a target of 100.0. That places it in Red.' (the customer's name is drawn in for 'the organisation'). Actions are stated once, in the counts line, with a pointer to the roadmap; the full before/after is in the word pack.

options.a: Approve as written (opening option A, actions-once option A)
options.b: Use the alternative: opening 'This assessment gives the organisation an overall score of 62.5 against a target of 100.0, which places it in Red.'
options.c: I'll give my own words in a note

default_action: Nothing changes until you approve; Tuesday holds the words.
